cpu_screen.candidate_definition: answerable numeric/table task with QA passed, source database validation complete, read-only SQL executable and nonempty, hidden gold supported by SQL result, and no deterministic semantic warning

rollout_time_model.assumption: both servers run independent TP8xDP2 Step120 rollout services concurrently; task-length mix may differ from the hard eval10 baseline

semantic_review_stratified_pilot64.assumption: 0.75 to 1.5 minutes per prompt-gold-SQL decision after deterministic packet preparation

decision.why: a 64-task pilot measures semantic approval and mixed-group yield in roughly one quarter of the full rollout time before committing 16 to 24 hours

bucket_policy.mixed: eligible for a fresh GRPO update after all remaining gates
bucket_policy.all_wrong: retain for correction or later rescreening
bucket_policy.all_correct: retain for regression or later rescreening

limitations: mechanical SQL and hidden-gold agreement do not prove that the prompt unambiguously entails the gold
the 60-minute rollout baseline comes from ten hard evaluation tasks and may overestimate or underestimate the new direct-query pool
the 48 to 96 minute semantic-review estimate is a planning assumption rather than a completed timing measurement
the 281-task pool must remain evaluation-disjoint and cannot be selected by hidden test performance
